notes.title: Bodhi n Friends Version 1.2 is here!
notes.content:
ADDITIONS:

- Added swinging animation to hanging cultists/Friends
- Added nails to wooden planks for more detail
- Added buzzing sounds to Electro Friends
- Added random flickering to some lights in the game studio.
- Peter can now be set on fire via the Burn Zone's burner during the chase sequence
- Mike can now die from Proto-Bodhi exploding after the boss fight if he is too close
- Added extra tabs for the flashlight & headlamp
- Added option for toggling ammo text
- Added particle-base lighting effects
- Added option for toggling particle-based lighting effects
- Added dropdown option for Anti-aliasing
- Added new game mode, Monster Crunch: Endless Arena, which can be accessed via the Monster Crunch Arcade or Extras menu
- Added a dropdown for Anisotropic Filtering
- Added Steamworks.NET
- If playing the Steam version, you'll see your Steam username & profile picture displayed on the main menu
- Added Steam achievements for Steam players
- Added option for toggling Edge Detection
- Added knockback to enemies/sheep when killed
- Added phase variants of a few combat themes
- Added smoke trailing after shooting Stun Gun, Tommy Gun, and Mike's Gun
- Added sounds for when Friends are stunned by Dazey the Stun Gun
- Added bullet effects coming from Mafia Friends' & Mike's (NPC) gun
- Added randomized swaying speed of hanging cultists/Friends
- When enemies are stunned, a stun effect will appear where the player shot
- When melee weapons hit any object, a sound will play
- Added extra detail to the terrain in the Thomas' Sheep Killing Frenzy arcade game
- Added lights whenever a gun is shot (Mike's pistol & Tommy Gun)
- Added a small story update called "Aftermath"
- Added light to Dazey the Stun Gun whenever it is fired
- Other minor additions

OPTIMIZATIONS:

- Blood, bullets and particle systems are destroyed instead of disabled after a certain period of time
- Disabled meshes that aren't visible to the player
- Other minor optimizations

notes.title: Bodhi n Friends Version 1.1 is now live!
notes.content:
[b]ADDITIONS:[/b]

- Added footstep sounds for when the player is walking on metal materials. 

- Added Thomas Sheep Killing Frenzy mini-game which can be accessed from the monster crunch arcade on the society level or the extras menu on the main menu. 

- Added a little easter egg at the studio level. 

- Added thunder which can randomly play when it is raining on the studio & Thomas' house level.

- Added a link to the Bodhi n Friends community discord server. 

- Added V-Sync Support. 

- Other unmentioned additions.


[b]OPTIMIZATIONS:[/b]

- New LOD Groups

- Sheep are now lower Poly

- New scripting optimizations

- Mafia Friend Tommy Gun optimizations.

- Disabled some lights across various levels. 

- Particle system optimization. 

- Changed several meshes. 

- Decreased Shadow cascades. 

- Decreased bone weight on low-end graphics cards. 

- Other minor optimizations. 


[b]BUG FIXES:[/b]

- Fixed lens flares being viewed from behind objects. 

- Fixed stun gun getting stuck. 

- Fixed nose material not changing. 

- Fixed some collision issues. 

- Fixed issue with "weeping angel". 

- Fixed some subtitle issues. 

- Fixed player movement animations.

- Fixed some AI for Peter. 

- Adjusted nav mesh on the society level. 


[b]NOTES:[/b]

For a full list of additions, optimizations & fixes, please check out the following:

https://ibb.co/McDJp6T
https://ibb.co/q9wDQ7B
https://ibb.co/VgN4sZ7
